about.metaDescription: Colombo Market is a South Asian grocery store at Herrenstraße 30 in Ravensburg. Shop Sri Lankan and Indian groceries online or collect in store.
about.title: About Us
about.heroTitle: Sri Lankan and Indian groceries, from Ravensburg to your kitchen.
about.heroBody: We are a grocery store at Herrenstraße 30 in Ravensburg, stocking rice, dal, spices and everyday cooking essentials from Sri Lanka, India and the wider South Asian kitchen. Order online for delivery across Germany, or come by the store.
about.photoAlt: The Colombo Market storefront on Herrenstraße in Ravensburg
about.introOne: Colombo Market is a grocery store for Sri Lankan, Indian and other South Asian cooking. Many of our customers are Sri Lankans and Indians living in Germany who are looking for the ingredients they know from home: the right rice, the right dal, the spices that make a curry taste the way it should.
about.introTwo: You do not need to have grown up with this food to shop with us. If you are curious about South Asian cooking, our shelves and our online shop are a good place to start.
about.introThree: You can order online for delivery within Germany or, where it is offered at checkout, collect your order in Ravensburg.
about.shelvesTitle: Everyday staples, grouped the way you cook.
about.shelvesBody: Here is a look at what is on our shelves. Each card opens that section.

rice.title: Rice
rice.body: Basmati from Tilda, Daawat, India Gate, Laila and Annam, plus ponni, sona masoori and jasmine rice.

lentils.title: Lentils, Beans & Dal
lentils.body: Toor, chana, moong and urid dal, red lentils, chickpeas and black-eyed beans.

spices.title: Spices
spices.body: Whole and ground spices, Madras and Jaffna curry powders, and masala blends from MDH, Shan and MTR.

flour.title: Flour, Semolina & Flatbreads
flour.body: Atta, rice flour, besan, rawa, dosa and idli mixes, and papadams.

sauces.title: Sauces & Cooking Essentials
sauces.body: Coconut milk, curry pastes, tamarind, sambol, pickles and canned fish.

snacks.title: Snacks & Sweets
snacks.body: Haldiram mixtures, murukku, Maliban biscuits, coconut chips and jam.

frozen.title: Frozen
frozen.body: Parotta, chapathi, samosas, grated coconut, jackfruit and yam.

about.mealsTitle: Two ways to fill a basket.

rice.title: A Sri Lankan rice and curry
rice.body: Ponni or sona masoori rice, red lentils for a parippu, Jaffna curry powder, coconut milk, dried curry leaves and a spoonful of katta sambol on the side.

dal.title: Dal and biryani
dal.body: Toor dal for the pot, basmati rice for the biryani, a biryani masala, whole spices such as cardamom, cloves and cinnamon sticks, and papadams on the side.

intro.title: Sri Lankan and South Asian groceries at Colombo Market
intro.p1: Colombo Market stocks groceries for Sri Lankan, Indian and South Asian cooking: basmati, ponni and sona masoori rice, dal such as masoor, urad and toor, flour, semolina and flatbreads, whole and ground spices, curry powder, sauces, sambol, tea, snacks and frozen foods like roti and paratha.
intro.p2: Order online with delivery anywhere in Germany – free shipping from {threshold}, otherwise {rate}. If you live nearby, collect your order for free at our store at Herrenstraße 30 in Ravensburg. New here? Start with the categories or our Sri Lankan favourites.

items.a: Orders are usually processed within 1–3 business days. Estimated delivery then takes a further 2–5 business days.

items.q: Can I pick up my order in Ravensburg?
items.a: Yes. If pickup is offered at checkout, you can collect your order free of charge from our store at Herrenstraße 30, 88212 Ravensburg. Please wait for your pickup confirmation before visiting the store.

items.q: How much is shipping, and when is it free?
items.a: We deliver anywhere in Germany. Shipping costs {rate}, and it is free for orders of {threshold} or more. Available shipping options are shown at checkout.

Contact us within 14 days of receiving your order. Returns generally need to be unused, unopened and in their original packaging. Exceptions apply to opened food products and perishable goods. Please contact us before sending anything back.

items.q: How can I contact Colombo Market?
items.a: For questions about orders, products, delivery or pickup, contact us by email at colombomarket.rv@gmail.com.
